variants.name: Tracerless
variants.info:
Ammo that doesn't have the components that create weapon tracers.

Greater overall accuracy for less range performance and bullet penetration.

variants.name: 14.5x114mm B-32
variants.info:
Load your NTW-20 with 14.5x114mm.

While the weapon itself isn't any lighter, the bolt is - allowing you to cycle the action significantly faster. The B-32 round has exceptional penetration and velocity, but loses one-shot kill potential at extreme ranges.

variants.name: 20x110mm HS
variants.info:
Load your NTW-20 with 20x110mm Hispano-Suiza.

Improves muzzle velocity and damage per shot, but reduces overall penetration.
